title: Counter Frontend project
description: A frontend counter project with React
fullDescription: A simple yet functional web application built to demonstrate the fundamentals of state management and user interaction in frontend development. The app allows users to increase, decrease, and reset a numerical counter dynamically.
features: Interactive user interface with real-time counter updates
Clean and responsive layout using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript / React.js
Modular and beginner-friendly structure for understanding component-based development

title: Restaurant Menu Viewer
description: An interactive frontend web application designed to display a restaurant’s digital menu in a clean and user-friendly interface
fullDescription: An interactive frontend web application designed to display a restaurant’s digital menu in a clean and user-friendly interface. Users can browse through various food categories, view item details, and explore pricing and descriptions seamlessly.
features: Dynamic menu layout displaying items by category (e.g., Starters, Main Course, Desserts, Beverages)
Responsive and visually appealing design optimized for both desktop and mobile devices
Search and filter functionality for quick item discovery
Built using reusable components for scalability and performance

title: Landing Page Design
description: A modern and responsive landing page for a tech startup, showcasing their products and services effectively.
fullDescription: A modern and responsive landing page designed to present brand information and engage visitors through an attractive, user-focused layout. The project emphasizes clean design principles, smooth navigation, and aesthetic visual balance to create a strong first impression.
